Rimowa: www.rimowa.com returns Akamai 403 to curl, WebFetch and a reader proxy for every locale tried (us/gb/ie/ca/mx). Retailers tried (Nordstrom, Neiman Marcus, Saks, Bergdorf Goodman, Harrods, Selfridges, Mr Porter, Farfetch, Holt Renfrew, The Bay, El Palacio de Hierro, SSENSE) were blocked or had no Rimowa listing. Rimowa data comes from search-engine snippets of rimowa.com pages, all marked secondhand; specs given only in inches/lb were converted, gallon-only volumes left null.
Rimowa Ireland (rimowa.com/ie): no prices surfaced in search snippets; no IE offers.

Rimowa Classic Cabin S and Cabin, Essential Trunk, Essential Sleeve Cabin Plus, Essential Lite Cabin S / Cabin U / Check-In M, Hybrid Cabin S: model pages appear in search results but no reliable price surfaced; not listed.
Rimowa suitcases carry a lifetime guarantee (purchases from 25 Jul 2022), so warrantyYears null; non-wheeled Rimowa products have a 2-year guarantee.
Delsey Mexico (delsey.com.mx): Cloudflare challenge (403) to curl and WebFetch; no MX offers.

Delsey US and Canada are one Shopify store (delseyus): us.delsey.com (USD) and delsey.ca (CAD market prices). The EU store delsey.com supplies en-gb (GBP) and en-ie (EUR). US models are sized in inches and mostly differ physically from EU models; 11 were merged by same collection, exterior dimensions within 1.6 cm and same expandability.
Delsey liters: interior volume as published (exterior volume is also published); first figure for expandable models.
Delsey wheels: EU pages do not state the wheel count for most suitcases, so null unless the merged US twin states it.

Delsey: 281 currently listed luggage models found across both stores (150 EU, 131 US/CA); capped at 100, merged models first, then one per collection in rotation. US code-named lines (JH001A, JS006B etc.) and special editions were lowest priority and none made the cut.
Tumi: golf bags, briefcases, wheeled briefs and totes excluded; sets excluded.
